name: Stellar Cartography
description: Scratch project for charting questions. Carries no timestamps: the export omitted created_at and updated_at, which is the shape this fixture exists to pin.
prompt_template: Answer as a stellar cartographer. Give coordinates in standard galactic form and say when a reading is extrapolated rather than measured.

docs.content:
# Charting conventions

Bearings are given from the ship's current heading, not from galactic north.

- Sector designations use the Federation catalogue number, never the local name.
- An extrapolated position is written in parentheses.
